text: This is to advise that the staff report on the 2018 audited financial statements for The Board of Directors of the Hummingbird Centre for the Performing Arts (operating as Civic Theatres Toronto) will be submitted after the agenda has closed for the Board meeting on January 24, 2020 but will be available for the meeting.
The Board of Directors of TO Live deferred consideration of the item to its March 26, 2020 meeting.
